title: The Mat for the Whole Village

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DREAMS AND AMBITIONS (DRM-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Big dreams, small dreams, secret dreams and silly ones: things villagers hope for, work toward, give up on, change their minds about, or simply enjoy imagining. Ambition is optional, and a dream that never comes true is not a sad ending.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an elder)

collection.description: An elder is weaving a mat for the whole village to sit on, and a friend asks to help: show the pattern, or do it alone for now.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has started weaving a mat. A big one. Big enough, when it's finished, for the whole village to sit on together at once. It's going to take years. (subject.He/she) may not finish it. People keep pointing this out, as if (subject.he/she) hadn't thought of it. Today (friend) sits down and asks what (friend.he/she) can do.

choices.label: Say (subject.he/she) Wants to Do It Alone for Now

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) shows (friend.him/her) the weave. (friend) gets the hang of it after a few tries. Now there are two of them. By the end of the season there are five. The mat is about the size of a hut. It still has a very long way to go, and it is the most popular place in the village to sit and talk.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: "Not yet," says (subject). "I want to do the middle myself. Then anyone can help." (friend) understands. (friend.He/she) comes back often to sit with (subject) while (subject.he/she) weaves. They talk about everything. The middle of the mat gets slowly bigger. Neither of them is in any hurry.
